rows.text: The guidance regarding non-GAAP diluted net income per share excludes known pre-tax charges related to estimated stock-based compensation of $0.44 per share for the first quarter of fiscal year 2027 and $1.71 per share for fiscal year 2027 and amortization of intangible assets of $0.02 per share for the first quarter of fiscal year 2027 and $0.09 per share for fiscal year 2027.
